subject: Starbucks Red Cup Day 2026
title: When was Red Cup Day 2026? Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Starbucks
answer: Starbucks Red Cup Day 2026 was Tuesday, Nov. 17. Customers who bought a seasonal beverage that day got a free, limited-edition reusable red holiday cup, while supplies lasted. Starbucks' holiday menu, with drinks such as the Peppermint Mocha and Caramel Brulée Latte, has been available since Nov. 5.
body:
Starbucks announced the date in its 2026 holiday lineup, and the cups were given out on Nov. 17. The returning holiday drinks include the Peppermint Mocha, Caramel Brulée Latte, Sugar Cookie Latte and Gingerbread Chai, all on the menu since Nov. 5, 2026.

Red Cup Day falls between two other holiday merchandise drops: a mystery "Surprise Box" collection of glass Bearista cold cups that went on sale Nov. 10, and the original Bearista glass cup, which returns to select coffeehouses on Dec. 1.
in_the_news: Starbucks' free reusable red cup giveaway took place on Nov. 17, 2026; the next holiday drop is the Bearista cup on Dec. 1.

faq.q: How did you get a free red cup at Starbucks?
faq.a: By buying a seasonal beverage on Red Cup Day; the free reusable red cup came with it.

faq.q: Can I still get a red cup?
faq.a: The giveaway was a one-day event on Nov. 17. Holiday drinks remain on the menu for the season.

faq.q: When does the Bearista cup come back?
faq.a: Mystery Bearista boxes went on sale Nov. 10, 2026; the original Bearista returns Dec. 1 at select stores.
